you.touch: The warning is about services going offline, from data breaches to sites pulled down for urgent patching. No specific attack was announced.

title: A startup's AI agents reached Anthropic's internal sales, HR and IT systems in under 12 hours
summary: Cathedral went through third-party business software. Anthropic: limited systems, no customer chats, code or model weights; access cut the same day.
img_alt: Racks of servers and network equipment in a dark server room
tag: AI agents broke into Anthropic's systems in 12 hours
label: confirmed
standfirst: Anthropic confirms the agents reached a limited set of its sales, HR and IT systems through outside business software. No customer chats, code or model weights. Access was cut the same day; Anthropic says the startup broke its bug-bounty rules.

you.touch: If you use Claude, Anthropic says no customer chats were touched. The warning is how they got in: not through the AI itself, but through the kind of outside business software almost every company, bank and school runs.
today: Turn on two-step login for your email. It takes about three minutes.

family.touch: Nothing here reached families. It is a reminder that AI tools now do real break-in work; the version that reaches homes is a cloned voice asking for money.
today: Agree a family safe word, so a cloned voice can be checked with one question.

money.touch: No payment or customer data was reported taken. But banks and shops run the same kind of outside business software, and this is the kind of door now being tested by AI.
today: Turn on two-step login for your email and your bank. It takes about three minutes.

work.touch: The way in was outside software wired into staff systems: sales, HR and IT. Every AI tool or agent your employer connects to those systems is another door of the same kind.
today: Don’t connect an AI tool to your work email or files unless your employer has approved it.

site.touch: The agents went through third-party business software, not Anthropic’s own product. Your weak point is likely the same: the outside apps that hold keys to your systems.
today: List the outside apps with access to your accounts and remove the ones you no longer use.

touches: Businesses that run the same third-party software; Anthropic says no customer chats were reached

title: OpenAI says its models disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis and proved Kakeya in all dimensions
summary: Lean-checked proofs are public; a Williams-Impagliazzo-Paturi group will vet the computing claim, and a David Gross group the physics.
tag: OpenAI says its AI cracked three famous math and physics problems
label: reported
standfirst: OpenAI says its models proved the local smoothing conjecture in every dimension, which settles the Kakeya and restriction conjectures, disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and produced existence proofs for quantum field theories including QCD. The math and computing proofs were machine-checked in Lean and released, but no outside expert has yet confirmed them.
receipt: All three results are OpenAI's claims as of Oct 26; independent review groups have only just started.
